issue: Entry does not persist after page reload
actual: Created entry "Integration test entry" appeared in view (6 entries shown), but after page reload, entry disappeared and count returned to 5 entries. Entry is not retained in storage.
evidence: Before reload: 6 entries including new "Integration test entry". After reload: 5 original entries only, new entry missing.

issue: Field configuration does not persist after page reload
actual: Created "Status" text field appeared in forms and both views before reload, but disappeared after reload. Field configuration not persisted to storage.
evidence: Before reload: Status field visible in table headers and sort options. After reload: Status field missing, only original 4 fields present.

Created entry with text "Type validation test", number 5, date 2026-12-31, and checkbox unchecked. Values saved and displayed consistently in both table and card views. Table shows: "Type validation test", "5", "Dec 31, 2026". Card view shows same values plus "No" for checkbox state.

Switched from card view to table view. Entry count remains 6. New entry "Type validation test" with values (5, Dec 31, 2026) displays identically in table view. All 6 entries remain intact in both views.

Table view sorted by Task Name (ascending). Switched to cards view - sort reset to "Sort" (none). Sorted cards by Priority (ascending). Switched back to table - still shows Task Name (ascending) sort with entries in original alphabetical order. Each view independently maintained its sort state.
Search function filters entries by text content. Searching for "Design" showed 1 matching entry. Clearing search restored all 6 entries. Search is case-insensitive ("design" also matched "Design").

Search matched "Design" case-insensitively, updated count to "1 entry matching 'Design'", and restored all 6 entries when cleared. Search is case-insensitive (tested with lowercase "design" and found same result).

issue: Search does not match formatted dates or checkbox states as displayed to users
actual: Search for "Jan 15" (formatted date) returned 0 results, even though "Design new landing page" entry displays "Jan 15, 2026". Search for "Yes" (checkbox state) returned 0 results, even though 2 entries have Completed checkbox checked and display as "Yes" in card view.
evidence: Tested search for formatted date "Jan 15" and checkbox state "Yes" - both found 0 entries despite matching values being visible in the UI.

issue: Manual reordering does not work when no sort is active
actual: Cleared sort successfully (entries returned to original order, drag action appeared in table). Attempted to drag entry-1 to entry-3 position, but entries did not reorder. No visible change in entry order after drag operation.
evidence: Drag action present but non-functional. Entry order unchanged after drag-drop attempt.
Number field (field-2) has HTML type="number" attribute. Attempt to enter "abc" was rejected by browser native validation. Field only accepts numeric input.

Date field (field-3) has HTML type="date" attribute. Attempt to enter invalid date "2026-13-01" was rejected with "Malformed value" error by browser native validation. Field only accepts valid calendar dates.

Before sort: 6 entries displayed. Sorted by Priority (ascending). After sort: still 6 entries, all field values preserved (e.g., "Design new landing page" still shows priority "1" and date "Jan 15, 2026"). Only the order changed, no data loss or modification.

Filtered entries by searching "Review" - showed exactly 1 entry matching (Review marketing materials with priority 2 and date Jan 18, 2026). After clearing filter, all 6 entries restored with all values intact. No data loss or modification.

issue: Checkbox field (Completed) displayed inconsistently between views
actual: In table view, the Completed checkbox field is not displayed in the table columns (only showing Task Name, Priority, Due Date). In card view, the Completed field IS displayed as "Yes" or "No". Same entry data displayed differently across views.
evidence: Table view fields: ["key","value","field-2.value","field-3.value"] (no field-4). Card view fields: ["key","value","field-2.value","field-3.value","field-4.value"]. Checkbox values visible in cards but not in table.

Field configuration dialog shows field types clearly labeled: Text, Number, Date, Checkbox. Entry forms provide type-appropriate controls: text input for Text fields, number input (type="number") for Number fields, date input (type="date") for Date fields, and toggle control for Checkbox fields.

issue: Checkbox values not displayed in table view, only in card view
actual: In entry form: checkbox shown as toggle control with clear checked (true) vs unchecked (false) state. In card view: checkbox states displayed as "Yes" (checked) or "No" (unchecked). In table view: checkbox column (Completed field) not displayed at all, so states not visible.
evidence: Table view missing field-4 (Completed) column. Card view shows all entries with clear "Yes"/"No" representation. Requirement specifies "both data views" but table view omits checkbox entirely.

Clicked "Due Date" sort option. Entries immediately reordered by date (Jan 14, Jan 15, Jan 18, Jan 20, Jan 25, Dec 31). Sort selector shows "Due Date". Status bar displays "Sorted by Due Date (ascending)". App remains usable with all functions accessible.

issue: Data import functionality not found or not implemented
actual: After thorough exploration of the UI including toolbar, fields configuration dialog, entry forms, and main view, no import button or import functionality was discovered. No file upload control or import menu option visible in the interface.
evidence: Checked toolbar buttons (Fields, Table/Cards, Add Entry, Sort, Search), fields configuration dialog, entry management options, and console logs. No import feature found. Unable to test import with schema validation.
